privacy.memory.notice:
Conversation memory
- What: my messages in channels where the operator turned on capture
- Use: the bot looks up earlier conversation when it answers
- External processing: message text may go to the configured model provider for search embeddings and summaries
- Edits and deletions: editing or deleting a message on Discord changes or removes it from memory too
- Withdraw: `!privacy withdraw memory` stops storing my new messages and removes the ones already stored
- Withdrawing does not affect talking to the bot or other features
privacy.fortune.notice:
Fortune: personal data consent
- Collected: Discord user ID and date of birth (required); birth time, gender and birthplace if you give them (optional)
- Purpose: your personal fortune, zodiac sign and fortune subscription messages
- External processing: the items you registered and your display name may go to the configured LLM provider to write the fortune. Nothing you left out is guessed
- Kept until you run `!fortune delete`
- Withdraw: `!privacy withdraw fortune` stops use and delivery at once. Your profile and subscription stay and resume if you agree again
- Delete: `!fortune delete` removes the profile and subscription
- The record of agreeing and withdrawing is kept separately as evidence
- Not agreeing does not affect any other feature
privacy.school_notice.notice:
School notices: personal data consent
- Required: Discord user ID, school, degree program, year for undergraduates
- Optional: department, interests and delivery time you give
- Purpose: pick school notices that match you and send them by DM
- School websites only receive requests for fixed public board URLs, never your data
- Notice analysis only uses public notice text; your profile is not sent anywhere
- Kept until you run `!notices delete`
- Withdraw: `!privacy withdraw school_notice` stops personalization and delivery at once; agreeing again resumes
- The record of agreeing and withdrawing is kept separately as evidence
privacy.transfer_notice.notice:
Transfer admission notices: personal data consent
- Collected: Discord user ID, the universities you pick, subscription state
- Purpose: send new official transfer admission notices of those universities by DM
- No scores, education history or contact details are asked for
- Admission offices only receive requests for fixed public list URLs
- No external AI is used to detect notices or write the DM
- Kept until you run `!transfer delete`
- Withdraw: `!privacy withdraw transfer_notice` stops delivery at once; agreeing again resumes
- The record of agreeing and withdrawing is kept separately as evidence

maintenance.recovery_required: Maintenance recovery is required. Open this page in a browser for the steps, or run the offline maintenance command after stopping the daemon.
maintenance.page.title: Masamong is stopped for maintenance
maintenance.page.stopped: The bot is not answering and its schedules are off until this is fixed. This page changes nothing by itself.
maintenance.page.step_stop: 1. Close this running copy so the commands can work. In a terminal (PowerShell or Terminal) run:
maintenance.page.step_run_many: 2. Then run ONE of these commands (the first is the usual choice):
maintenance.page.step_start: 3. When it says it is done, start Masamong again (the app icon, or: masamong open).
maintenance.page.none: No command can fix this safely by itself. Do not delete any file. The files in the data folder that start with a dot and contain ".old-" hold your previous data. Ask for help and send logs/daemon.log.
maintenance.case.restore_requested: A backup restore was requested, but it could not be completed. Nothing in your current data has been changed yet.
maintenance.case.restore_started: A backup restore was interrupted after it began replacing files. Your previous data is set aside and can be put back.
maintenance.case.reset_requested: A reset (erase everything) was requested but has not started.
maintenance.case.reset_started: A reset (erase everything) was interrupted halfway.
maintenance.case.update_resumable: A program update was interrupted. It can be finished, or the previous programs can be put back.
maintenance.case.update_stuck: A program update was interrupted, and the programs now in the install folder are not the ones it expected (they were probably reinstalled or replaced by hand).
maintenance.case.journal_invalid: A maintenance record could not be read (it is damaged, or it was written by another version).
maintenance.case.journal_invalid_started: A maintenance record could not be read, and recovery files show that your data was being replaced.
maintenance.case.legacy_marker: A maintenance marker from an older version was found and cannot be continued.
maintenance.case.other: Masamong found unfinished maintenance work and stopped to be safe.
maintenance.effect.retry.default: Continues the interrupted work where it stopped and finishes it.
maintenance.effect.rollback.default: Puts the previous data or programs back. Everything the interrupted work changed is undone.
maintenance.effect.cancel.default: Forgets the request. Nothing has been changed, so nothing is lost.
maintenance.effect.cancel.aside: Moves the unreadable record aside (it is kept next to your data, named maintenance-refused-…) so Masamong can start. Look at it first if you are unsure.

memory.mine.title: What I remember about you
memory.mine.empty: I do not keep anything about you in this server yet.
memory.mine.footer: Only you can see this. To delete it, use /forgetme. Server admins can also see and delete it in the console (Memory).

memory.forget.title: Forget about me
memory.forget.preview: This deletes {items} item(s) about you, takes you off {episodes} conversation(s) and deletes {cards} card item(s). It cannot be undone.
memory.forget.nothing: There is nothing about you to delete in this server.
memory.forget.stale: What would be deleted changed since the preview. Check it again:
privacy.profile.notice:
Notes about me
- What: on servers where the operator turned person cards on, a short card of facts I said about myself on several days
- Use: replies to me, or in the same conversation, may draw on it
- Withdraw: `/privacy withdraw profile` deletes my cards, makes no new ones and leaves my lines out of the room style analysis (conversation memory itself stays)
